Name: PersistentBuffs
Author: aceynk
Description:
[size=5][b]PersistentBuffs[/b][/size]

Persistent buffs is a SMAPI (C#) Stardew Valley mod.
It allows Content Packs to make buffs persist across days and saves.

This mod does nothing on its own.

This mod is open source: [url=https://github.com/aceynk/PersistentBuffs/]https://github.com/aceynk/PersistentBuffs/[/url]

[size=4][b]Dependencies[/b][/size]

Requires SMAPI ([url=https://smapi.io]https://smapi.io[/url])
Content Packs likely require Content Patcher ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915[/url])

[size=4][b]Mod Authors: How to use[/b][/size]

I'll give an example of how to use a Content Patcher content pack to designate a buff as persistent.
This assumes you already have some knowledge with making Content Patcher mods.

First, find a buff you want to make persistent.
I'll make a custom one, with the entry below:

[code]
{
"Action": "EditData",
"Target": "Data/Buffs",
"Entries": {
"{{ModID}}_PersistentSpeed": {
"DisplayName": "PersistentSpeed",
"Duration": 10000000,
"IconTexture": "TileSheets\\BuffsIcons",
"IconSpriteIndex": 9,
"Effects": {
"Speed": 1
}
}
}
}

[/code]
(see [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Migrate_to_Stardew_Valley_1.6#Custom_buffs]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Migrate_to_Stardew_Valley_1.6#Custom_buffs[/url] for more information)

Next, let's assign the buff to a food item (or whatever you want to use to add the buff).
I'll assign it to carrot items, with the entry below:

[code]{
"Action": "EditData",
"Target": "Data/Objects",
"TargetField": [
"Carrot"
],
"Entries": {
"Buffs": [
{
"BuffId": "{{ModID}}_PersistentSpeed"
}
]
}
}[/code]
(see [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/blob/develop/ContentPatcher/docs/author-guide/action-editdata.md]https://github.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/blob/develop/ContentPatcher/docs/author-guide/action-editdata.md[/url] for more information)

Now, the PersistentSpeed buff will be applied whenever a carrot is eaten.
Next, to make the buff persist throughout days and saves, one more patch is needed.
Add the buff id (here, it's "{{ModID}}_PersistentSpeed" (where {{ModID}} resolves to the id set in the mod manifest)) by targeting PersistentBuffs/PersistentBuffIds.

[code]{
"Action": "EditData",
"Target": "aceynk.PersistentBuffs/PersistentBuffIds",
"Entries": {
"{{ModID}}_PersistentSpeed": true
}
}[/code]

Combining these patches, every carrot now gives a +1 speed buff that lasts through days and saves.

Manifest.Description: Allows creation of buffs that persist through sleep.
